invariants.rationale: The method immediately checks if 'name' is null and returns early, suggesting that subsequent code assumes 'name' is non-null.
'name.length()' is non-negative if 'name' is non-null, so the sum does not decrease 'x'.
'String.length()' is always non-negative when 'name' is not null.
'isEmpty()' and 'length() == 0' are equivalent for Strings; one must be true if the other is.
'x' is an int parameter and always satisfies the lower bound of Integer.MIN_VALUE.
